name: gbMod
description: An R Shiny application for moderation analysis using Hayes’ PROCESS methodology, with regression diagnostics and visualizations.

name: gbMed
description: An R Shiny application for mediation analysis. The gbMed.R application is maintained within the gbMod repository.

name: gbEFA
description: An R Shiny application for exploratory factor analysis and related diagnostics, including factor retention and correlation-matrix options.

name: BioKubios
description: A tool for reading and transferring Biopac ACQ files to a Kubios samples file for batch processing.
